verses.verse:
स्वराणामन्तराले च सन्ति नादा अनेकाशः।
श्रूयते तत्र यो भिन्नः स नादः श्रुति संज्ञकः।१३९।
verses.text: In the spaces between the notes there are many sounds; the one among them that is heard as distinct is the sound called śruti.

commentary.text: Although in the śāstra of music differing views are found on whether the śrutis are equal or unequal, yet on this matter all are of one opinion: among the many sounds (nāda) lying in the space between the notes, those whose difference, though subtle, can be heard are called śrutis. [Still finer] intervals of sound, in number [beyond these], can also be seen by means of instruments, but we cannot give them the name śruti, because those differences depend on instruments - human life cannot always rely on these instruments.

terms.en: śruti — the audibly distinct pitch between svaras
